en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a two‑storey inn or guesthouse with arched windows and a hipped roof, labeled as an old German 'Gasthof'. In front of the building stand several people near the entrance, with outdoor benches and tables along the facade. To the right, a horse-drawn carriage is visible on the road. Trees line the street and there is open grassland in the foreground. The top of the card has German text indicating the name and location of the inn and the proprietor.
